newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tight spot supply boosts Bremen coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: Tight spot supply boosts Bremen coffee prices.

text.p: Outright arabica prices in the Bremen market were $6-8 up on the week per 50 kg fob in repsonse to tight spot supplies and firmer futures levels.
Traders said supplies of mild arabicas were especially tight but roasters appeared generally well covered so that trade volumes were thin.
Latin American differentials were higher and African prices also increased along with a firmer Kenya auction, which helped raise Tanzanian, Zimbabwean, and Malawian prices in its wake.
Robusta markets were quiet, with Vietnam being the most aggressive seller.
